main_text.p: 3421.Ædificium templi & instauratio vrbis impeditur viuen-teadhuc Cyro.Esdr.4.v.5. item sub Cambyse, & Dario Hyftaspide, ibid.v.6: item sub Xerxe, ibid. v.6: item sub Artaxerxe Longimano,ibid.v.7.18. &feqq. vsque ad annum secundum Darii Nothi.3430.3465.3486.3527. ibid.v.vlt.
3471.Assuerus, id est, Xerxes, ducit Estheram vxorem. Esth. 1.
main_text.head: Septimum interuallum, a templo secundo fundato vsq; ad eius excidium.10
main_text.p: 3527.Anno secundo Darij Nothi inchoatur ædificatio templi.Esdr.4.v.vlt. Haggæus & Zacharias vaticinantur. Hic incipiunt 7 o septimanæ Dan.9.
3532.Anno sexto Darij Nothi templum abfoluitur.15 Esdr.6.v.15.
3551.Anno septimo Artaxerxis Mnemonis Esdra proficiscitur Hierosolymam, magno instructus comitatu, & reformat ibi vtramque politiam,ec-clesiasticam & ciuilem.Esdr.7.8.9.10.20
3563.Nehemias, accepto nuntio de aduersis rebus in Iudæa, jejunat & orat.Nehem.1.
3564.Nehemias anno 2o Artaxerxis Mnemonis venit Hierosolymam permissu regis, & muros ciuitatis per annos 12. instaurat.Neh.2. &feqq.25
3575.Anno 31 Artaxerxis Mnemonis desinente muri Hierosolymæ sunt perfecti, annis 49, siue septem septimanis, à secundo anno Darij Nothi & initio hebdomadum Dan.9. Confer Esdr.6.v.14.
3619.Darius Codomannus vincitur ab Alexandro Ma-gno.30 1. Maccab. 1.v.1.
3626.Alexandro Magno rebus humanis exemto, imperium eius cedit ducibus ipsius.1. Maccab. 1.v.6. &feqq.
3781.Antiochus Epiphanes Hierosolymam capit, & templum profanat.35 2. Maccab.5.

page.notes: Printed "teadhuc" at line start after the hyphen "viuen-" appears to lack the word space ("te adhuc"); transcribed as printed. Date "3527." beside "ibid.v.vlt." is hard to confirm and may read differently. Catchword "Iudas" printed in italic at lower right. Long s printed as "f" in some reference words (Efdr., Efth.) is rendered as plain s per convention.
